summary: Gogo Inc. filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026 reporting that it and wholly owned subsidiary Gogo Intermediate Holdings LLC entered into the third amendment to their April 30, 2021 credit agreement with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding as administrative agent. Consenting lenders extended maturities by converting term loans into 2026 Extended Term Loans: $544.4 million maturing October 31, 2030, alongside $33.4 million Initial Term Loans maturing April 30, 2028. The amendment mandates prepayments of $25.0 million at closing, $30.0 million by December 31, 2026, and $20.0 million by December 31, 2027, with 0.75%-1.25% quarterly amortization. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation; watch deleveraging pace and lender participation in the conversion mechanic.
